caption: The drawing depicts a lidded container, likely a soup tureen, rendered in grayscale. The container has a rounded, bulbous body with ornate, engraved patterns along its upper side and a decorative cartouche in the center of its main body. The lid is domed with a faceted knob handle at the top. On either side of the container, there are two angular, elongated handles that rise above the rim. The container stands on four spherical feet, each positioned at a corner under the base. The medium appears to be pencil or charcoal on a plain, light-colored background. The shading gives the object a metallic appearance, and the engravings are shown in fine detail. At the lower left corner of the drawing, there is handwriting that reads "Tálalós-Zupa."
title: Silver Bowl
